R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>כמין ט׳</he>, read: <he>כמי נִילוֹס</he> like the inundation of the Nile (so did the fire spread from the furnace when it was broken through); v. <cite ref="A00834"><he>אוקיי</he></cite>. [The entire passage from <cite ref="K00616"><he>כיצד</he></cite> to <cite ref="A00834"><he>אוקיי</he></cite> belongs to VII, 9, after the words: <he>מכאן שנפרץ הכבשן</he>; v. <cite ref="Q01011"><he>פְּלַטְיָא</he></cite>.]
